scope: Current-turn literature search and primary-source reads; not a systematic review or novelty certification. No third-party paper code executed; no restricted old PDF reacquired.

entries.title: Smart Forecasting of Carbon Prices Using Machine Learning and Neural Networks: When ARIMA Meets XGBoost and LSTM
entries.reading_level: Publisher search-returned abstract and date only
entries.implication: Carbon-price averaging hybrids already exist; do not present a stronger conventional combination as new architecture. Full timing, datasets, tuning and significance procedures not audited.

entries.title: Semi-Structured Distributional Regression
entries.reading_level: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata; no full method read
entries.implication: Statistical-neural models and orthogonalizing deep components are established; our anchor identities do not imply population orthogonality.

entries.title: A New PHO-rmula for Improved Performance of Semi-Structured Networks
entries.reading_level: Official PMLR abstract page opened; no paper PDF read
entries.implication: Identifiability restrictions can impair estimation; post-hoc orthogonalization is an existing comparator concept, not an implemented paper reproduction here.

entries.title: GAMI-Net: An explainable neural network based on generalized additive models with structured interactions
entries.reading_level: Publisher search abstract/Highlights; direct open returned Internal Error. Author abstract returned by search, not full methods.
entries.implication: Separating main effects and interactions is established; this is not evidence that our whole estimator is mathematically identical.

entries.title: Sparse additive function decompositions facing basis transforms
entries.reading_level: Publisher HTML bibliographic/abstract page opened, not a full-paper proof audit
entries.implication: Anchored decomposition itself is known. The mixed-difference identity used in our code is elementary and is not a new theorem.

entries.title: LiD-GLM: Lipschitz-constrained Deep Generalized Linear Models
entries.reading_level: Accessible author HTML, relevant Section 2/M1-M2 and orthogonalization passages read; not all proofs or experiments reproduced
entries.implication: Controlled neural deviations from a statistical baseline and retained baseline identities already have direct neighbors. Our network does not implement i-ResNet invertibility or the paper's monotonicity guarantee.

entries.title: Forecasting Carbon Dioxide Price Using a Time-Varying High-Order Moment Hybrid Model of NAGARCHSK and Gated Recurrent Unit Network
entries.reading_level: Author abstract as indexed by PubMed, no full paper
entries.implication: Using statistical model states or parameters as GRU inputs is not a sufficient novelty statement.

entries.title: SKOLR: Structured Koopman Operator Linear RNN for Time-Series Forecasting
entries.reading_level: Official PMLR search-returned abstract only; not used to claim implementation equivalence
entries.implication: Linear-state and nonlinear measurement-function hybrids are an active existing family, not an empty field.

tested_claim: Only whether this fixed reference-relative anchored mixed-difference recurrent architecture improves over same-core residual, additive, unrestricted hybrid and simple combinations in the permitted development prefix.
